rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Arkansas (hybrid tea, Weeks, 1980)
rows.Bloom: Orange-red, darker veining. Mild, spice fragrance. 45 to 50 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Medium, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit: Tall, few or no prickles/thorns, upright, well-branched. Medium, medium green, dense foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Hardy. vigorous.
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 4,700 VIEW USPTO PATENT
rows.Notes: The State of Arkansas was admitted to the Union on 15 June 1845.
